scope: Actual bundled pointer-page profile, independent source-backed corpus, native-data/pointer/ZP/bank edits, precise CPY FF write order and unknown retained attribute, declared structural recognition, malformed/ambiguous refusal and authoring/emulator isolation. Includes independent direct execution of the original loader through bundled 6502/PPU buses; no full-game, browser or hardware acceptance.
